messages.name: Order placed
messages.description: Tells the shopper their order was placed, on the checkout setting messageChannels.

email.subject: We received your order {number}

messages.name: Order status
messages.description: Tells the shopper their order moved into a status whose notify is on. With the checkout setting statusTemplates per_status, ecommerce.order_status.<status key> is sent instead: your template for that status, else your template for this message, else these words.

email.subject: Your order {number} is now {status}

sms.text: Your order {number} with {business} is now {status}.{?trackingUrl} Track it: {trackingUrl}{/trackingUrl}

messages.name: Claim status
messages.description: Tells the shopper where their return, exchange or warranty claim is: when it is made and at each staff step.

email.subject: Your claim {claim} is now {status}

sms.text: {business}: your claim {claim} for order {number} is now {status}.{?amount} Refunded: {amount}.{/amount}

messages.name: Back in stock
messages.description: Tells a shopper who set an alert that a product is back in stock, on the alerts setting channels.

email.subject: {name} is back in stock

sms.text: {business}: {name} is back in stock. {url} Stop alerts: {stopUrl}

messages.name: Price drop
messages.description: Tells a shopper who set an alert that a product's price dropped, on the alerts setting channels.

email.subject: Price drop: {name} is now {price}

messages.name: New order
messages.description: Tells the staff about a new order (staff alert event placed).

email.subject: New order {number}: {total}

messages.name: Order moved
messages.description: Tells the staff an order moved into another status, other than a cancel (staff alert event status).

email.subject: Order {number} is now {status}

messages.name: Order paid
messages.description: Tells the staff an order became paid (staff alert event paid).

email.subject: Order {number} is paid

messages.name: Transfer proof sent
messages.description: Tells the staff a shopper sent the proof of a bank transfer (staff alert event proof_uploaded).

email.subject: Transfer proof for order {number}

messages.name: Order canceled
messages.description: Tells the staff that they or the shopper canceled an order (staff alert event cancelled).

email.subject: Order {number} was canceled

messages.name: Order canceled: time ran out
messages.description: Tells the staff an order was canceled because its time to pay or to be confirmed ended (staff alert event expired).

email.subject: Order {number} was canceled: time ran out

messages.name: Refund due
messages.description: Tells the staff that money for a canceled order arrived at Payments after the cancel, so it is to be refunded (staff alert event refund_due).

email.subject: Refund due on order {number}

sms.text: Order {number}: {amount} arrived after the cancel. Refund it.{?link} {link}{/link}

messages.name: New claim
messages.description: Tells the staff a shopper made a return, exchange or warranty claim (staff alert event return_requested).

email.subject: New claim {reference} for order {number}
